decision_scope: whether the same selected A saved signals show technically coherent per-sample original-to-corrected behavior and independently local detectable signal sufficient to inform design of a first trained comparison

historical_result.preservation_rule: The original FAIL, its four unit-278 remap failures, all original global-peak distances, visibility flags, and metric tables remain immutable historical outputs. Corrected QC writes a new namespace and does not overwrite, relabel, or delete them.

field_binding.rigid_projection: median across depth after exact executed shape validation
field_binding.reference: median of the full-session rigid projection

clock_and_edges.retained_global_frames: [frame_1-60, frame_2+61) for a pair and [frame_1-60, frame_1+61) for a single
clock_and_edges.exact_edge_rule: numpy.searchsorted(right_edges, sample_times, side='right'); an exact shared edge belongs to the later cell
clock_and_edges.state_rule: derive one rounded state per retained sample from the bound field; receipt state_um is descriptive event-center metadata and must not be broadcast over a member

frozen_selections_and_thresholds.signal_and_baseline_windows: unchanged from v1: singles signal [40,101), pairs [40,101+lag); baseline [0,30) plus [111+lag,121+lag)

corrected_semantics.per_sample_remap: For each retained sample, corrected[target,t] equals original[mapping(state[t],target),t], or zero where that state/target lacks exact support.
corrected_semantics.anchor: The corrected coordinate anchor is fixed by the prior unit-channel table. State-specific original fixed anchors are disabled. Original comparisons use per-sample remapping into corrected coordinates.
corrected_semantics.support: Support is a channel-by-time Boolean mask from the exact mapping for each sample state; a slot-wide or event-center support label is not used for sample comparisons.
corrected_semantics.correlation: Optional correlation is computed only on frozen corrected-local-domain channel/time samples that are supported under the corresponding per-sample mappings; it is descriptive, never an integrity or detectability gate.
corrected_semantics.q0_identity: Whole-array original/corrected identity is enabled only when every retained sample state is exactly zero; otherwise it is disabled and replaced by the per-sample positive remap check.
corrected_semantics.negative_controls: No-shift and per-sample wrong-sign controls are enabled only when at least one sample state is nonzero and the alternative predicted array differs from the positive expected array. Disabled controls are reported, not counted as passes.
corrected_semantics.stage_domain: raw_counts, temporal_centered, and CAR_centered only; native high-pass remains excluded because retained snippets lack original 512-sample padding

local_detectability.domain: channels within <=80 um of the frozen corrected-coordinate anchor, chosen before outcome inspection
local_detectability.metric: maximum CAR-centered ptp_snr inside the frozen local domain
local_detectability.global_peak: reported descriptively over all 384 channels but never used to select a local channel, establish localization, or gate detectability
local_detectability.noncircularity: No peak-distance<=80 criterion exists. Membership in the predeclared local domain and the thresholded local metric are the only detectability inputs.
local_detectability.pair_use: short-pair slots remain descriptive/integrity-only and do not enter unit usability

interpretation_rules.integrity: all archive hash/key/shape/dtype checks and all per-sample exact-remap positives pass; every enabled negative control passes; conditional q0 identity passes where enabled
interpretation_rules.unit_usable: at least two of its three corrected-A single-event slots meet local detectability
interpretation_rules.PASS: integrity passes and at least 3 of 4 units are usable
interpretation_rules.CAUTION: integrity passes and exactly 2 of 4 units are usable
interpretation_rules.FAIL: integrity fails or fewer than 2 units are usable
interpretation_rules.scope_limit: The verdict is a technical saved-array screen only and cannot establish any prohibited claim.

output_schema.figures: disabled to minimize output and avoid implicit waveform publication

stop_conditions: any unexpected archive key, shape, axis, dtype, field key, field edge, or state
any resource ceiling would be exceeded
any attempt to open a recording path, train, detect, sort, tune, access RF/holdout, or publish waveform arrays
completion_condition: After a separate independent GO only: all compact outputs are durable, hashes verified, and COMPLETE.json written last with zero recording reads and no waveform export.
